component_ecl_doc: The pool is not the bare Component: hematocrit is Erythrocyte with the property volume fraction
_loinc_survey_doc: LOINC-side recall survey (Loinc.csv of the pinned LOINC release): regexes on COMPONENT / PROPERTY / SYSTEM that select the LOINC terms a laboratory physician would count as this analyte (CLASSTYPE 1, not DEPRECATED). The generator reports how many of them the LOINC Ontology pool reaches.

queries.name: Refined Query V2 (Property-Specific: Volume Fraction)
queries.description: Uses Component = Erythrocyte AND Property = Volume fraction (118586006) to separate Hematocrit from RBC count (which uses Number concentration). This prevents cross-contamination between measurements that share the same Component.
